changeSet.author: car-reservation
changeSet.comment: The API has no car creation endpoint, so the 10,000-car fleet is seeded here.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO car (id, make, model, license_plate) SELECT uuidv7(), -- PostgreSQL 18 native; same time-ordered key shape as the application (ARRAY['Toyota', 'Volkswagen', 'Skoda', 'Renault', 'BMW'])[1 + g % 5], (ARRAY['Corolla', 'Golf', 'Octavia', 'Clio', 'X1'])[1 + g % 5], 'BG-' || lpad(g::text, 5, '0') FROM generate_series(1, 10000) AS g;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM car WHERE license_plate LIKE 'BG-%'
